Opportunity looks different for every generation.

The Modern Worker Empowerment Act provides consistency and clarity in how an independent contractor is defined, making it easier for workers to find jobs that allow for flexibility and independence. To strengthen our economy and create opportunity, our laws must evolve alongside today’s workforce. #Opportunity250
